experiment: Native Score bridge and Generic Space fan-out v6
limits: Native Score values are Jev outputs; normalization and weighted composites are deterministic code with fixed predeclared profiles.
Existing MS and GS are axes of compatibility, not an exclusive list of correct answers. Weights encode a preference, not universal bridge quality.
Geometry, region extraction and two new schema proposals are generated by code; Jev scores/ranks supplied hypotheses rather than inventing free-form Generic Spaces.
All ten historical Generic Spaces are evaluated, plus two generated hypotheses. The repository has five proposition records, not a full Euclid library.
Structural/metric binding checks are independent gates. A model score does not certify proof or allow a composite to compensate for a missing premise.
The 8-versus-100 comparison has four timing pairs and 32 overlapping Score observations; it does not demonstrate 200 or 2000 distinct theorem schemas.
Per-request default context is 64k and per-question context 32k. No long-context header is enabled. Body limit is 32 MiB; no separate question-count cap is documented.
Claims about 200/2000 schemas are sizing scenarios, not live measurements or invented corpus contents.
